reviews.title: Feature idea: in-flight Pomodoro breaks
reviews.text:
Hi! I really enjoy using FocusFlight, and I wanted to suggest a small feature.

It would be great to add optional Pomodoro-style breaks during longer flights. For example, after 50 minutes of focus, a seatbelt chime, turbulence announcement, or meal service could signal a 5–10 minute break. Then another cabin sound could let you know it’s time to continue studying, while the same flight keeps going.

Thanks for your work, wish you success and growth!

reviews.title: Really helps me focus. One idea to make it even better.
reviews.text:
I've been using FocusFlight for a while and it's the only focus app that actually made me keep coming back. Booking a flight before I start working sounds like a small thing, but it changes how the session feels. I pick where I'm flying from and where I'm going, turn on Airplane Mode so my distracting apps get blocked, and then I just work until I land. The cabin sound in the background helps a lot too. Watching my routes fill up the map and my miles going up keeps me going on days when I really don't feel like starting.

One thing I keep thinking about while I'm "in the air" is that it feels like I'm the only person on the plane. It would be amazing if you added a way to see other real users who are focusing at the same time.

What I have in mind:

See who else is flying the same route as me right now, and where other people are flying from and to
See how long each person has already been in the air, so you can see who's on a long-haul session
Leaderboards by country and worldwide, so people can compete a little on focus hours
Save favorite "passengers" so I can fly the same route with them again later

The biggest thing for me is just not feeling alone while I focus. When you know other people around the world are in the air at the same time, it's much easier to stay in your seat and finish the work. A friendly leaderboard would push a lot of us to do one more session too. I think it would bring in a lot of new users.

Of course privacy matters, so it should be optional — let people hide their name or fly private if they want.

Thanks for building this. Five stars from me either way.

reviews.title: Not good on MacOS
reviews.text:
Disclaimer: Using on MacOS.

For an app that is supposed to help me focus, I had to click a million things before starting.

I would like to keep the map visible on the screen while I work, reminding me to stay focused. And behaving like an in-flight map on the TV. But the app won’t resize to be small.

After I finished my first journey, I would have liked an easy way to start my next journey from my landing site. This way, I could travel contiguously, layover-style.

Instead, I will uninstall. Nice idea but needs a lot of improvements.
